# Parcel (green): a box 0.8 x 0.5 x 0.6 m wrapped in green, tied with a cream cross of twine;
# origin at its bottom centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Wrap --base-color 0.3765 0.6824 0.4824 --no-slot
material new Twine --base-color 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Box --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.250
scale 0.800 0.600 0.500
apply --scale
material assign Wrap
add mesh cube --name TwX --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.250
scale 0.140 0.700 0.600
apply --scale
material assign Twine
active TwX
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name TwZ --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.250
scale 0.900 0.140 0.600
apply --scale
material assign Twine
active TwZ
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Knot --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.585
scale 0.220 0.220 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Twine
active Knot
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export parcel_green.glb
